study.title: Senescent activated naive B cells promote anti-citrullinated antigen T cell responses and the transition to clinical rheumatoid arthritis
study.assay: paired longitudinal peripheral-B-cell 10x GEX and CITE-seq ADT matrices deposited as separate MEX libraries
study.claim_if_successful: donor-disjoint prediction of longitudinal RNA-protein dependence across healthy controls and ACPA-positive rheumatoid-arthritis risk states

split_rule.within_stratum_order: ascending SHA-256 digest, then physical donor identifier
split_rule.paired_visit_rule: Both visits and all modalities from a physical donor remain in one split and one resampling block.

panel_rule.selection_basis: one-to-one RNA gene to ADT target mappings fixed from official feature definitions without reading any assay value
panel_rule.required_resolution: each RNA symbol and exact ADT axis string resolves exactly once in every one of the 26 corresponding feature axes
excluded_categories: CD45 isoform antibodies without transcript-isoform resolution
HLA-DR and CD32 antibodies with ambiguous gene mapping
CD3 because the ADT target does not select one CD3 transcript

states_and_sampling.barcode_pairing: Remove exactly one terminal -1 from a GEX barcode, then require exact equality to a unique barcode in the same donor-visit CITE axis; use the intersection only.
states_and_sampling.cell_selection_scope: within physical donor and visit after exact barcode intersection and RNA-only QC
states_and_sampling.rna_state: raw GEX UMI count greater than zero
states_and_sampling.adt_state: within donor-visit midrank split into equal low and high halves of the selected even cell count
states_and_sampling.destroyed_link: one-step cyclic shift of each complete 45-marker ADT state vector within donor-visit along the frozen salted cell order
states_and_sampling.minimum_support: A donor-visit with fewer than 128 eligible paired barcodes is a terminal support refusal; no donor or visit substitution is permitted.
states_and_sampling.selected_cell_count_rule: Let m be the eligible paired-barcode count. Select the first min(512, 2*floor(m/2)) salted keys; this count must be at least 128.

source_selection.folds: leave one physical source donor out, holding both visits out together
source_selection.primary_family: paired longitudinal graph-regularized exact fixed-margin conditional coupling field
mandatory_comparators: visit-aware selected signed Pearson or signed-root Poisson-deviance residual transfer
visit-specific common-effect exact conditional maximum likelihood
visit-specific pooled saturated Poisson fixed-interaction reconstruction at recipient margins

held_confirmation.primary_metric: physical-donor-equal mean multinomial deviance per cell, first averaged equally over that donor pre and post visits

access_sequence: publish and independently verify designation, amendment, implementation, and tests before any numeric matrix GET
write an immutable source attempt before requesting only the 28 source matrix files
publish a terminal source result and consumption record; held URLs remain unreachable unless every source gate passes
after a public source pass, reduce held GEX matrices into sealed RNA states, selection-barcode hashes, and public RNA margins without requesting held CITE matrices
in a separate process, reduce held CITE matrices into sealed ADT states and public ADT margins without loading RNA states
publish recipient-margin predictions from public source coordinates and public held margins before any held pairing
publish score authorization, then pair sealed held states once in a network-disabled process and score
